Field-level Firestore config, applied add-only by backend/gas/scripts/ensure-firestore-field-config.mjs. ttl = Firestore deletes the document by itself once the timestamp field expire_at (written by FirestoreStore, TTL_RULES) has passed: no read, no job. indexExemptions = long text fields that are never filtered or sorted, so no single-field index is kept for them (less storage, cheaper writes). A field used in a where/orderBy must never be listed here.
